forever.name: no-bare-except-pass
forever.description: Bare except: pass blocks silently swallow errors. Excludes ebook_drm vendored code.

forever.name: primary-classes-must-inherit-igorbase
forever.description: D125 enforcement: primary component classes (cognition/, memory/, tools/, network/, brainstem/) must inherit IgorBase. Exempts classes whose only bases are third-party (BaseModel, Enum, ABC, dataclass, etc.).

forever.name: no-sqlite-imports
forever.description: CLAUDE.md hard rule: NO SQLITE in Igor's own data path. Excludes legitimate external SQLite consumers (Calibre catalog, Kindle DRM keychain). T-remove-sqlite-references is the cleanup; this is reintroduction prevention.

forever.name: no-hardcoded-instance-refs
forever.description: T-hardcoded-instance-refs (#458): Igor runtime must not hardcode 'Igor-wild-0001' / 'choose_a_password' outside known-exempt files (paths.py, docstrings, node_id constant). Exempt list is the settled baseline from the 2026-04-15 sprint.

forever.name: no-cortex-store-bypass
forever.description: T-cortex-store-bypass-audit: runtime tools/ files must not INSERT INTO memories directly; all writes go through cortex.store() per DP4 (single chokepoint). Exempts seed_*.py and memory_sync.py.
